outcome: The factory now records only a task LIST at decomposition and gates each task's detailed contract behind a just-in-time grill: forge delegate <task> refuses a write launch without a fresh, digest-bound passing per-task grill (decision 0032, amending 0007). A task's write_scope/tests/acceptance are authored against what earlier tasks actually built, then grilled, then delegated — so speculative upfront contracts that produce wrong code are gated out. The board renders each task's JIT grill status and a done story's PR link.
